newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Prisco shareholders vote capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Prisco shareholders vote capital rise.

text.p: Shareholders at shipping company Prisco voted to raise authorised capital to 553.05 billion roubles from 442.44 million roubles by redenominating shares, a senior company official said on Wednesday.
AOOT Primorskoye Morskoye Parokhodstvo vice-president Yevgeny Kozmin told Reuters the face value of shares would change to 25,000 roubles from 20 roubles.
Officials have said PRISCO planned the rise to reflect an increase in the value of its fixed assets.

The company's biggest shareholders are CS First Boston with nine percent of shares, Norway's AS Lora with 1.2 percent, the company's management with 11 percent, individuals with 30 percent, and PRISCO Stocks about 38 percent.
The company posted a loss of 10 billion roubles in the first half of 1996, compared to one billion roubles in loss in the first half of 1995.
